name: wavedash_wes
about: melee player. i main fox. yes i know. i have a CRT in every room including the bathroom (for warmups). i can explain wavedashing to anyone in under 4 minutes and i WILL, you don't have to ask, in fact you can't stop me.

interests.General: melee (there are other games? cute), CRTs (8 and counting), controller port maintenance, frame data, explaining wavedashing to anyone standing still, gamecube controller collecting, the smashboards forums at 3am
interests.Music: dragonforce (through the fire and flames, obviously), the melee soundtrack (pokemon stadium is peak), muse, whatever song is on the ken combo video, whatever's on at the local
interests.Movies: the karate kid (it's about tech skill), rocky (it's about tech skill), the wizard (it's not about tech skill but it IS about a kid and a tournament), akira (looks INSANE on a CRT)
interests.Television: g4 (attack of the show, x-play), ken vs isai on my own VHS tapes, dragon ball z (the training arcs only, skip the talking)
interests.Books: the melee frame data spreadsheet (a book if you print it, I did), the official SSBM strategy guide (wrong about everything, historically important), ender's game
interests.Heroes: the 20XX prophecy, ken, isai, the guy at the venue who brings the good CRT, my mom (does not know about CRT #8)

hometown: his parents' basement (which is in Sacramento, technically)
zodiac: Capricorn (I main a bird but I'm a goat. work ethic. frame data.)
status: Single (the CRTs are a lifestyle, not a partner. mostly.)
hereFor: Friends, Networking, Friendlies (bring your own controller, I WILL inspect the ports)
meet: ken. isai. PC chris. anyone who has beaten a fox in bracket without johns. also whoever at sony decided to stop making trinitrons, so I can ask them, calmly, why.
pcComments: nice pic. is that a CRT in the background? 27 inch? trinitron? answer all three. this is important.
this photo has good neutral. you're centered, you're spacing correctly from the camera, no johns. solid.
cool. the shutter shades though. those are scanlines for your face. I respect it, technically.
the flash on this pic has the exact latency of a 2001 plasma. 4 frames. I can tell. still a good pic.
you're holding a gamecube controller in this and the analog stick looks WORN. whose is that. is it ok. do you need me to look at it.
statusesExtra: wavedash_wes hosted friendlies and SOMEONE brought an HDTV 'to help.' it added 4 frames of lag and I aged 4 years. no names. you know who you are. thanks for coming though.

wavedash_wes played Halo at youth group as a favor. it has no wavedash. it has no L-cancel. it has a 'sticky grenade,' which is a projectile with johns built in. josh is good at it though. concerning.
wavedash_wes found a 27-inch trinitron on the curb on trash night. carried it 6 blocks. that's CRT #9. my mom thinks it's still 7. we're all lying to someone.
wavedash_wes is watching the 13 new members' profiles load on CRT #3. scene layouts at 640x480 should be illegal. the glitter is 4 frames behind the text.

josh: josh you beat me at Halo 8 times in the youth room and I want to be clear: Halo is not melee, there's no tech skill, it's aim and grenades and a jeep. anyway what's your sensitivity and can I come back thursday.
ok. real talk. you have tournament-level composure. you didn't celebrate once. that's scarier than celebrating. come to melee night. I will put you on fox. you will hate it. you will be good at it.
epic: epic. you linked me a YTMND of fox's up-throw up-air looped to 'what is love' and I have watched it 40 times. that's a combo video. you made a combo video by accident. respect.
'lol ur mom wavedashes' is not a joke, it's a statement of respect toward my mom, who does in fact have excellent reaction time. she's caught 8 CRTs falling. 8.
nate: nate the shutter shades. on a CRT at 640x480 they're just horizontal scanlines on your face. it's actually kind of a great effect. don't take this as encouragement.
'some people need to grow up' is a solid headline but you posted it during my friendlies and three people looked at their phones mid-match. that's 200 frames of downtime. post it AFTER the set, dude.

kevin: kevin. real talk. Butterfly on heavy is basically a tech skill exercise, your feet are hitting 1-frame links. you would be DISGUSTING at melee. I have 7 CRTs. zero lag. think about it.
an AAA with no witnesses is still an AAA. in melee we call that a wavedash in the woods. I believe you, kevin. bring the sweatband to my basement.
dave: dave you 'h4ck3d' the LAN party sign-up by writing your name twice. respect. anyway you're carrying the fourth CRT, they're heavy, THAT'S the real skill test.
l33tspeak is just fancy DI for words. also stop asking to 'overclock' my CRT. it's a 1998 Trinitron. it is already perfect. I have measured.
derek: derek a kickflip is basically a wavedash: dash (push), jump (ollie), air-dodge diagonally into the ground (the part where you fall). you're already doing melee tech. badly. like me at skating.
watched your gap video frame by frame on CRT #3. you were 2 frames from landing it. that's one missed L-cancel of margin. so close it hurts, man.
randy: randy. Chuck Norris doesn't wavedash, the stage moves under him. there. happy? now please stop posting on my wall at 2am, it's frame-perfect annoying.
'PIE.' is not an argument randy, but neither is my 400-word post about ledge invincibility, so we're even. you'd make a good falco player. that's an insult btw.

statuses: wavedash_wes acquired CRT #8. don't tell my mom. it has a name. its name is also wes.
wavedash_wes explained wavedashing to three new members today. zero asked. all were changed.
wavedash_wes is hosting friendlies saturday. 4 setups, no johns, controller ports cleaned with rubbing alcohol like a professional.

bulletins.subject: PSA: melee night is BACK (new members read this)
bulletins.body: friday. my basement. 8 CRTs (long story, don't tell my mom). melee singles, casual friendlies, and I will explain wavedashing to anyone who stands still long enough. it is NOT a glitch, it is an intentional physics interaction and it will change your life. new members: yes you can play, no you don't need your own controller, but if you bring one I WILL inspect the ports. kevin bring the sweatband. dave you're on CRT duty. -wes
